glosses: A love song that is sung directly to one's love interest, especially one performed below the window of a loved one in the evening.

examples.text: From me to thee glad serenades, / Dances for thee I propose saluting thee, adornments and feastings for thee, / And the sights of the open landscape and the high-spread sky are fitting, / And life and the fields, and the huge and thoughtful night.
A lovestruck Romeo sings the streets a serenade / Laying everybody low with a love song that he made

Gehoord van pr-man Frank, volgens wie het een zinderend spektakel was 'omdat het nogal wat emoties met zich meebracht'. Bart knikt. 'De hele ruimte stond vol.
